scope: 18 actual normal-text iPhone 17 Pro frames: welcome, tuner and first guitar lesson explain card for hi/gu/kn/ml/mr/pa. Every individual source image was directly opened and visually inspected.
conclusion: No demonstrated visible localization layout or missing-glyph defect in these 18 captured normal-size frames.
limits: This is an independent AI visual review, not native-human linguistic or script-shaping certification.
Only captured normal-size phone states reviewed; no Dynamic Type, tablet, landscape, interaction, VoiceOver runtime or universal accessibility claims.
Lesson review covers first explain card at step 1/5, not the remaining four steps or the full lesson corpus.
Screenshots bind exact base 970; they do not visually verify later source or translation fixes.
No live source, translations or tests were modified. Any future product fix needs new native captures.
